about: Which audio-library takes become which bank takes (tools/audio/build_bank.py). Take ids are the library's candidates.json ids. A take spec is {id} (whole file), {id, start, len}, {id, slices: n, min, max} (separate events of a multi-take recording) or {mix: [layers]} (layers {id, start?, len?, max_len?, delay, gain}). target_db is the take's mean level after editing (peak capped at -1 dBFS); bank volume_db sets the mix on top. Music: kind "music" (stereo Vorbis loops), take ids "suno/<track>/<file>.wav" (the library's music/suno/), {id, start, bpm, bars} loops on exactly that many bars from the downbeat at start, bank {"music": "<track id>"}; "loop": false on a group keeps a sting's own ending. Chosen 2026-10-22 from library metadata and measurements, not by ear: the owner swaps takes with local/audio-library/audition.html (repository root, gitignored).
levels_about: Event volume_db for the mix (bank.json), applied by every build: recorded takes are full level, the old synth ones were not (steps sat at -37 dBFS). Set from a captured play-through on 2026-10-22 where the master limiter worked most of the battle at 0 dB everywhere; retune by ear.
